name: Auction Hearts
summary: A bidding variant of Hearts where players auction the right to choose which suit carries penalty points.
rules_text: Played with a standard 52-card deck, 4 to 6 players, each dealt 13 cards when four play. After the deal, an auction is held. Eldest hand opens by bidding a number of chips they will pay for the right to name the penalty suit. In clockwise order players may pass or bid higher. The highest bidder pays their bid into a pool and declares the penalty suit, e.g. Hearts, Spades, etc. Then trick-taking begins with eldest leading. Players must follow suit if able. No trumps. Highest card of led suit wins trick and leads next. Goal is to avoid capturing cards of the declared penalty suit. After all tricks, each penalty card taken costs one chip or point, 13 total. The player with fewest penalty cards wins chips from others equal to their counts, or lowest total score wins. Play continues to agreed total.
rating_reason: Auction variant of Hearts, bidding plus trick-avoidance strategy.
